references.text: John 11:5 confirms the same love (φιλέω) mentioned in verse 3 by stating that Jesus loved Martha and her sisters.
John 11:36 shows how the Jews interpreted the statement that Jesus loved (φιλέω) Lazarus, confirming that this loving relationship was known to all.
John 11:11 describes Lazarus as 'fallen asleep,' which is the direct result of the illness (ασθενεῖ) reported by his sisters.
In John 11:21, Martha repeats the message from verse 3 by saying: "Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died", thereby confirming that Jesus loved him.
